terms_summary: BMG and Concord will combine under the BMG name. Bertelsmann will own about 67% and affiliates of Great Mountain Partners about 33%, and those affiliates will also receive a one-time cash payment of $1.16 billion. Closing is expected in the second half of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions.

Avex Music Group acquired producer Infamous's catalog as its first purchase under a new catalog initiative supported by City National Bank. Financial details of the purchase were not disclosed; the initial $100 million is the first phase of a broader catalog commitment, not the price of this deal.

Concord, through its subsidiary Concord Cadence, will acquire Round Hill Music Royalty Fund, which trades on the London Stock Exchange, via a board-recommended offer of $1.15 per share, a 67.3% premium to Thursday's (September 7) closing price. The article gives no closing timeline.

Blackstone's rival proposal offers $1.24 per share in cash, versus Concord's $1.16 per share offer, which the board has accepted. The board says it would be minded to recommend the Blackstone proposal if Blackstone announces a firm offer, and it is providing due diligence access. No firm offer has been made yet and no closing date is given.

Sony Music Publishing has acquired Hipgnosis Songs Group LLC (formerly Big Deal Music), including its 4,400 copyrights and the Words & Music US publishing admin business, from Blackstone's Recognition Music Group. Price and closing timing were not disclosed.
Spears sold the rights to her music catalog to publisher Primary Wave, per an anonymous source with knowledge of the deal. Closing timing and other structure were not disclosed.
Pophouse has completed a transaction making it majority owner of the music interests of Tina Turner's catalogue, alongside BMG and the Tina Turner Estate. Terms were not disclosed.

Litmus Music acquired a portfolio of compositions, including select music publishing copyrights, from benny blanco, covering hundreds of songs and numerous multi-platinum hits. Capital came from Carlyle Global Credit's Credit Opportunities strategy; financial terms and closing timing were not disclosed.
